seo.titulo: AI clips from podcasts and long videos for agencies | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Clipfine's AI finds the best moments in every client episode, with a score, a reason, a title and a hook. Fewer hours watching video, more clips out the door.

destacado: a batch of clips to pick from
bajada: Clipfine transcribes your client's episode and the AI suggests the moments that stand on their own, each with a score and a reason. Your editor starts by choosing, not searching.

d3.que: each moment's score, with its reason

p1.p: How many clips does the AI pull from an episode?
p1.r: Up to 15 moments per episode, 15 to 90 seconds each, sorted by score. You choose which ones to edit and can add clips by hand from the transcript.

p2.p: What does the AI look for in a moment?
p2.r: That it stands on its own and has something that hooks: a strong hook, a controversial opinion, a complete story, a quotable line, humor, emotion or a surprising fact. Each moment says which one it is.

p3.p: Can my editor change what the AI suggests?
p3.r: Yes. The span, the title and the hook are suggestions: they're adjusted in the editor before the clip is scheduled.

p4.p: Can I ask the AI for specific moments, for example from a webinar?
p4.r: Yes. On the episode, click ✨ Several clips and write what you want ("one clip per topic", "the practical tips"). The AI finds those moments across the whole video, you pick which ones and they're created together, up to 20 at a time. If you already have the timestamps, paste the list. You can also ask from ChatGPT or Claude with the Clipfine connector.
